title: Expression of Concern: HAB1–SWI3B Interaction Reveals a Link between Abscisic Acid Signaling and Putative SWI/SNF Chromatin-Remodeling Complexes in Arabidopsis
content: This is an expression of concern regarding: Angela Saez, Americo Rodrigues, Julia Santiago, Silvia Rubio, Pedro L. Rodriguez, ‘HAB1–SWI3B Interaction Reveals a Link between Abscisic Acid Signaling and Putative SWI/SNF Chromatin-Remodeling Complexes in Arabidopsis’ The Plant Cell, Volume 20, Issue 11, November 2008, Pages 2972–2988, https://doi.org/10.1105/tpc.107.056705
